messages:
Marcus (VP Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the reliability incident — posting the RCA + action items we promised. RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-tokenizer-outage and timeline: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-tokenizer-outage#timeline
Priya (SRE): Thanks Marcus — can we call out which actions are blocking customer SLAs right now?
Marcus (VP Eng): Short list in the RCA under 'Immediate mitigations'. Blocking: fallback routing for hosted tier, alert tuning, and a hotfix to the tokenizer fallback.
Ethan (Product): Is there a single ticket we can point customers to for status? Liam (Support) can we expose that?
Liam (Support): Yep — I created INC-1423 in Jira and linked it in the RCA. Public status page will point to that ticket. https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INC-1423
Zoe (Eng-Infra): Action for infra: enable degraded-mode routing by default for cross-region bursts. Owner: @Zoe. ETA: next deploy window (48h).
Priya (SRE): Action for alerts: reduce noise + add proper severity labels. Owner: @Priya. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Marcus (VP Eng): Hotfix action: tokenizer fallback patch. Owner: @Marcus and @Ava to approve expedited release. ETA: 24h if approvals go through.
Ava (CEO): Approved for expedited release. Please follow release checklist and ping me on Slack once the patch is in canary.
incident-bot: Created task lists and reminders: /tasks INC-1423 -> 5 subtasks assigned. Due dates set.
Ethan (Product): For roadmap questions from the Q&A — how will this change prioritization of model rollout features? Marcus?
Marcus (VP Eng): We'll postpone non-critical model rollout optimizations until SLA actions are in place. Roadmap PR will reflect that; PR link: https://git.internal.redwood.com/roadmaps/reliability-prioritization
Liam (Support): Customer comms: First batch of emails going out in 2 hours. Draft in the RCA comments for review. Owner: @Liam and @Ethan.
Priya (SRE): One more ask from on-call: can we get an ETA on extra paging for the tokenizer metric? Zoe, can infra wire that to PagerDuty?
Zoe (Eng-Infra): On it. I'll add a synthetic for tokenizer latency and hook to PD. ETA 12h.
Marcus (VP Eng): Summary of owners in one line: tokenizer hotfix -> Marcus, infra routing -> Zoe, alerts -> Priya, customer comms -> Liam/Ethan. If anyone needs different ownership speak now.
Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone. Please update the RCA with any new notes and mark your subtask done when complete. We'll review at the next all-hands follow-up. :thumbsup:
Liam (Support): Quick note — I added a FAQ section to the RCA for CS to use.
Priya (SRE): Logged postmortem follow-ups into the reliability board. Assigning cross-team reviews.
Marcus (VP Eng): Closing thread for now — will post incremental updates here and in the RCA comments. If you want a live sync, DM me.
